title: Concept: Gitea console is reachable without authentication
description: A self-hosted forge holds source, CI webhook secrets and often package registries. An exposed instance with open registration lets the caller create an account, read whatever is public by default and reach the exploration API.
applicability: Responses that serve an administrative or diagnostic interface from a host reachable by ordinary users.
risk: The caller reads repository contents and the user list, and with open registration obtains an account inside the forge.
